yahoo/AAPL-2026-10-09-1d.json.note: Written by hand in the chart API v8 schema: five daily bars to the 2026-10-09 close. Every capture attempt was rate-limited (HTTP 429).

yahoo/AAPL-2026-10-09-1m.json.note: Written by hand in the chart API v8 schema: one-minute bars around the 2026-10-09 close. Every capture attempt was rate-limited (HTTP 429).

yahoo/AAPL-2026-10-12-close.json.note: The official AAPL close of 2026-10-12 and the last three one-minute closes, transcribed from one live response read with a browser User-Agent at about 19:20 CDT. The response bytes were not saved, so there is no checksum of them; sha256 covers this file. Fields that were not transcribed are left out.

yahoo/MSFT-2026-10-09-1m.json.note: Written by hand in the chart API v8 schema: one-minute bars around the 2026-10-09 close. Every capture attempt was rate-limited (HTTP 429).

yahoo/MSFT-2026-10-12-1d-intraday.json.note: Written by hand in the chart API v8 schema: five daily bars whose last is still in progress, so record it during the regular session. Every capture attempt was rate-limited (HTTP 429).

yahoo/not-found.json.note: Written by hand in the chart API v8 schema: the error body for an unknown symbol (HTTP 404). Every capture attempt was rate-limited (HTTP 429).

yahoo/rate-limited.txt.note: HTTP 429 body, byte for byte, from a request with a browser User-Agent.

alpaca/snapshots-7-iex-2026-10-14.json.note: Snapshots of the 7 tickers on the free plan's real-time feed (IEX), during the 2026-10-14 session. Byte for byte.

alpaca/sip-recent-refused.json.note: HTTP 403 body, byte for byte: the free plan refuses SIP data newer than about 15 minutes. The same body came back for 1-minute SIP bars from 5 minutes earlier.

alpaca/bars-1min-AAPL-MSFT-2026-10-13-se.note: One full regular session of 1-minute SIP bars (390 per ticker), 09:30 to 15:59 ET. Byte for byte.

alpaca/bars-1day-7-2026-10-13-sip.json.note: Daily SIP bars for the 7 tickers, 2026-10-06 to 2026-10-13. The 2026-10-13 AAPL close (341.27) equals that day's official closing print. Byte for byte.

alpaca/bars-1min-7-2026-10-13-close-sip..note: 1-minute SIP bars from 15:45 to 16:15 ET around the 2026-10-13 close, for the 7 tickers; bars from 16:00 on are after-hours. Byte for byte.

alpaca/bars-1min-AAPL-2026-10-13-close-i.note: The same window on the IEX feed, which has no bars after 15:59 ET. Byte for byte.

alpaca/trades-AAPL-2026-10-13-close-sip..note: AAPL SIP trades in the first 500 ms after the 2026-10-13 close, including the closing print (conditions 6 and M). Byte for byte.

alpaca/unauthorized.html.note: HTTP 401 body, byte for byte, from a request sent with a deliberately invalid key.

alpaca/rate-limited.json.note: Written by hand in the documented error schema: an HTTP 429 body. A capture would mean exceeding the rate limit on purpose, so it was not attempted.

alpaca/stream-iex-trades-2026-10-14.json.note: One short websocket session on the IEX stream (connect, auth, subscribe to trades for the 7 tickers, the first messages), during the 2026-10-14 session. Server messages are as received; the client auth message holds placeholders instead of the credentials. The transcript was written by the capture script, so sha256 covers this file.

alpaca/stream-iex-quotes-2026-10-14.json.note: One short websocket session on the IEX stream (connect, auth, subscribe to trades and quotes for the 7 tickers, the first messages), during the 2026-10-14 session. Server messages are as received; the client auth message holds placeholders instead of the credentials. The transcript was written by the capture script, so sha256 covers this file.
